newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Wheels gets GM aluminum wheels pact.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Wheels gets GM aluminum wheels pact.

text.p: Hayes Wheels International Inc said on Tuesday it had received a contract from General Motors Corp to supply fabricated aluminum wheels for several mid-size vehicle platforms.
Hayes also will supply aluminum wheels for the Chevrolet Lumina, Oldsmobile Silhouette and Pontiac Trans Sport minivans beginning with the 1997 model year.
Hayes said shipment of the lightweight fabricated aluminum wheels began in July from its manufacturing facility in Romulus, Mich.

"This contract is indicative of the continued effort by automakers to reduce vehicle weight," said Ron Cucuz, Hayes chairman. "Since its introduction in 1994, our lightweight fabricated aluminum wheel technology has been chosen by several leading automotive manufacturers in the U.S. and Europe to meet their weight-reduction requirements without sacrificing strength or quality."
Hayes said a fabricated aluminum wheel is 45 percent lighter than a traditional steel wheel and nearly 20 percent lighter than its cast aluminum counterpart.
